instructions_to_main_agent: Build a PWA-style mobile-first layout. Use max-w-md mx-auto for the main container (`app_container`) to constrain the width on desktop, simulating a native mobile app experience.
Import Google Fonts 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (for headings) and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (for body) in index.html.
Do NOT build a generic 'Urban Company' clone. Use the provided Deep Teal (#0C54A4) and Warm Amber (#8D3E00) to create an organic, premium, fresh feel.
Component logic: Use React state to mock the flow (Splash -> Role Select -> OTP Login -> Home -> Service List -> Checkout -> Tracking).
Ensure the booking tracking screen uses the detailed vertical stepper defined in the components section.
Mock data for services should include: Installation, Filter Change, Repair, AMC.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, bottom nav items, category cards).
Use standard .js files for React components. Do not use .tsx.
Use Lucide-React for icons. Keep stroke-width at 2px. For the active state in Bottom Nav, apply fill-current.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and generous white space.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (e.g. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85) for sticky headers and the bottom nav.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties like transition-transform or transition-opacity.
Do NOT center-align the app container content by default. Left-align textual content for natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-xl) with interaction animations (active:scale-[0.98]).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Padding p-5 or p-6 is standard for cards and sections.
NEVER use placeholder image URLs like via.placeholder.com. ONLY use the provided image URLs from the image_urls block.
Use `sonner` for toasts if notifications are needed. Ensure its UI matches the rounded, premium aesthetic.
